positions.title: Cyber Security Analyst - Database/Web Developer
positions.description: Work with Asp.Net MVC C#, Javascript, Json, CSS, applications using technologies such as Kendo Telerik, JQuery, Ajax, Json, TFS, Git, Access database, Visual Basic, Microsoft SQL Server Database, SQL, Sharepoint and others.  Develop and debug code; work in host and virtual environments. Working on Sipr and Nipr sides.  Develop and fix Legacy and newer MVC applications. Write database scripts and create procedures.  Preparing to transition to the Cloud.  Attend meetings; develop documents for the development environment.  Mix with the customer and other users/stakeholders.
